_doc: Extra registry: the new-definition census as `v1census2`, beside `v1census` (which this branch also moves to version 2). Delete this file once every lane reads v1census at version 2.

v1census2.doc: v1census version 2 under another name (the M5 measure fixes, RLC-055), so tables that read v1census keep working until the coordinator switches: pass --registry tools/review/pool/measures_v1census2.json --measures v1census2. V1 item 1's seven measures on the final frame (decisions log 2026-10-21); since 2026-10-23 they are realism checks whose targets are where each fires, outside Earth's Phanerozoic range (docs/science/realism-checks.md, RLC-014 to RLC-075) plus the crust's net change and the sea over the datum; definitions in measure_v1census.py. Version 2 (2026-10-25, RLC-055): coast_hi on Fibonacci points, the sea the world ocean, the reach over land; coast_hi_old is version 1's value
